timing: Recorded before any outcomes from this experiment were calculated or inspected.
reason: Clarify staged account resets, the comparison baseline, and holdout isolation without changing the matrix, ranking, or pass thresholds.

clarifications.stage_accounting: Discovery, validation, and holdout each start from a fresh 100R account; capital and realised profit do not carry between stages.
clarifications.baseline_use: Evaluate the comparison baseline in validation alongside selected candidates. Evaluate it in holdout only if at least one selected candidate passes validation.
clarifications.holdout_isolation: Do not generate, simulate, rank, or report 2025 signals or outcomes unless a selected candidate first passes the frozen 2024 validation gate.
clarifications.comparison_scope: The baseline is contextual and cannot replace a candidate or alter candidate selection. Report candidate-minus-baseline return, drawdown, expectancy, profit factor, and trade count where available.

unchanged: candidate ranking and maximum of three selections
